result.summary: Found several visual defects: overlapping/garbled text on a restaurant card, a truncated restaurant name, and a missing delivery fee on another listing.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text ('25-30') overlaps and collides with the word 'delivery', producing unreadable garbled text ('25-30delivery').
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so delivery time and the 'delivery' label have proper spacing (e.g. '25–30 min delivery') and do not overlap; ensure text wrapping and line height are correct.

issues.description: The third restaurant in 'Fastest near you' has a truncated name: 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Allow the full name to display (wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with ellipsis only after a complete word) so users can identify the restaurant.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows delivery time but no delivery fee amount (unlike the cards above that show e.g. '€0.90 delivery'), leaving pricing incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Display the delivery fee consistently with other listings (e.g. '€X.XX delivery' or 'Free delivery') next to the time.
